summary: Iteration 10 — Leaderboards + Daily Challenges + WebSocket + Spectator + auth-redirect fix all verified end-to-end. BACKEND (pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10.py): 10/10 passing. (a) GET /api/leaderboard?scope=global returns up to 100 rows sorted by xp desc with correct is_me + numeric my_rank; scope=friends returns just self for a lonely user, and includes an added friend after POST /api/friends/add. (b) GET /api/challenges returns exactly 3 daily challenges with the full progress/goal/complete/claimed shape; deterministic (two different users see the same rotation for the same UTC date). (c) POST /api/challenges/claim/{id} correctly rejects unknown ids (404) and incomplete challenges (400). (d) Challenge progress accrues after a match ends — join match, wait for 'active' phase (~8s lobby countdown), leave -> _eliminate -> _schedule_persist -> apply_progress bumped at least one metric on today's rotation. (e) WebSocket /api/match/{id}/ws: an invalid token is rejected (Cloudflare surfaces the 4401 close as a 403 handshake failure, both are valid rejections); a valid token receives a personalised state frame with match_id/phase/'me' block matching the authenticated user. FRONTEND (Playwright mobile viewport 390x844, real preview URL): (1) auth screen loads, name-only guest login navigates to /(tabs) with find-match-btn visible. (2) Leaderboard modal — trophy icon on play menu opens the screen; GLOBAL tab shows 100 rows + YOUR RANK chip (#101 for the fresh guest), FRIENDS tab shows just the self row (Rookie · LVL 1 · 0 wins), back navigation returns to menu. (3) Daily Challenges card opens the screen; renders 3 progress bars with today's rotation (Rampage, Final Ten, No Panic in this run), summary text '0 / 3 COMPLETE · resets at midnight UTC', no claim buttons visible for a fresh user (all IN PROGRESS) — matches the spec. (4) Match flow: find-match -> lobby -> active in ~9s, panic-button visible & tappable, self-eliminated after 2 presses. Live state (players_alive dropped from 100 to 96) was updated via the WS/polling transport. (5) Spectator view: after self-elimination while match still active, SpectatorView (testID=spectator-screen) rendered with SPECTATING banner, YOU'RE OUT / 'Eliminated at #97 of 100', STILL ALIVE = 96, YOUR KILLS = 1, live elimination feed, VIEW MY RESULTS (spectator-results-btn) + LEAVE TO MENU (spectator-leave-btn). Tapping VIEW MY RESULTS transitioned to the results screen (ELIMINATED / #97 of 100 / 1 kill / +41 XP EARNED / Patience +2 / CONTINUE). (6) auth auto-redirect fix VERIFIED — navigating to /auth while logged-in now redirects back to / and shows find-match-btn (regressed as an open item in iter9; the useEffect added to /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx:29-31 correctly router.replace('/(tabs)') when user becomes truthy). Residual (unchanged from iter9): (a) 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' RN-Web warning on match/[id].tsx:311 reveal Animated.View; (b) IBM Plex TTF fonts fail to decode via the preview proxy (OTS invalid sfntVersion) — falls back to system font on web only, native unaffected.

critical_code_review_comments: /api/leaderboard synthesises my_rank via db.users.count_documents({'xp':{'$gt': me.xp}}) when the user is outside the top-100 window — correct behaviour and verified with a fresh guest showing my_rank≈101.
challenges.generate_daily(date_iso) seeds Random with int(YYYYMMDD) and samples 3 from CHALLENGE_POOL — verified deterministic across two users on the same UTC date.

game.MatchManager.persist_player is idempotently guarded via _persisted_pids (set) so multiple _schedule_persist calls (elim + safety-net after end) don't double-count XP/matches. apply_progress runs on the fresh user doc AFTER the $inc XP write, so its update_one({daily_challenges}) doesn't clobber the just-written xp field.

WebSocket handler match_ws() correctly closes with code 4401 on jwt.PyJWTError and 4404 on missing match/user before accepting; personalised state_for(user_id) is sent immediately after accept. Verified via websocket-client against the wss ingress.

auth.tsx now has `useEffect(() => { if (user) router.replace('/(tabs)') }, [user, router])` (line 29-31) — resolves the iter9 UX gap where a valid restored session left the user stuck on /auth. Verified live: goto('/auth') while logged-in redirects back to '/' and shows the play menu.

SpectatorView in match/[id].tsx renders when state.phase=='active' and me.alive===false, with correct testIDs (spectator-screen, spectator-remaining, spectator-results-btn, spectator-leave-btn). VIEW MY RESULTS toggles the results overlay using the my_result server payload without waiting for match end.

rca_of_issue: No new bugs surfaced this iteration. Prior iter9 residual (auth screen not auto-redirecting when session restored) was resolved by main agent — verified live in this run: navigating to /auth with a valid JWT in secureStore now redirects to /(tabs) within ~1s. Backend WebSocket rejection for a bad JWT is emitted as a WS-close code 4401 by FastAPI (see /app/backend/server.py:640 `await websocket.close(code=4401)`); the Cloudflare ingress upgrades this to an HTTP 403 handshake response so external clients see the rejection as a WebSocketBadStatusException(403) rather than a close frame — behaviourally correct but worth noting so tests accept either form.
